title: eludite.navigation.go_to_all input
description: Go To All (Ctrl+T, Ctrl+,), Go To File (Ctrl+Shift+T, Ctrl+1 Ctrl+F), Go To Type (Ctrl+1 Ctrl+T), Go To Member (Ctrl+1 Ctrl+M) and Go To Symbol (Ctrl+1 Ctrl+S): search the workspace's files (the Workspace window's tree, ranked by fuzzy match) and the symbols every language server of the workspace reports (`workspace/symbol`). The query may start with Visual Studio's filter prefixes: `f ` files, `t ` types, `m ` members, `# ` symbols, `: ` a line of the active document. A newer query drops the answers of an older one.

query.description: The search text, prefix included. Omit to open the popup (with `open_popup`) or to read the current results.

filter.description: Restrict the search, as the prefixes do (a prefix in `query` wins). Default `all`.

max_results.description: Results returned at most (default 100, at most 500).

select.description: Navigate to result `select` (0-based, in the order of the output's `results`) of the current query, as Enter does, and close the popup.

open_popup.description: Show the Go To All popup (the keys do). Default false for agents.
